strongest_evidence: Recent Taiwan buyer requests show recurring e-commerce operations and month-close outsourcing intent.
Independent 104 listings show the same workflows consume paid labor.
PRO360 completed-service reviews prove category-level transactions for e-commerce outsourcing, accounting, tender proposals, crawler work and data entry.
weakest_claims: Exact fixed-scope payment for either e-commerce wedge.
Narrow segment fit when sources do not disclose company size/vertical.
Standalone tender preflight and recurring document/monitoring product demand.
contradictions: Broad incumbents may already satisfy buyers.
Marketplace reviews are selected and do not establish prevalence.
Recurring demand can still be labor-linear.
unsupported_precision: No TAM, CAC, LTV, retention, conversion or exact savings estimates are asserted.
next_evidence_to_collect: Seek accepted quotes or scheduled commitments for the two e-commerce scopes and record segment details without widening category evidence into exact-wedge claims.
